[ITST.5.3.2] **The two suites name differently:**

| Suite | Name | Example |
|---|---|---|
| spec/ | `test_<id>__<tag>`, the spec section ID lowercased with dots → underscores | `test_idsp_2_3__null_cb_silent_drop` |
| impl/ | that form for a scenario that tests a clause; otherwise a descriptive name | `test_iret_11_2__same_rule_fires_by_timetag_not_by_hash`, `test_all_levels` |

Spec tests use spec IDs because the function name IS
the spec citation per [ISTS.3].
Most impl tests exercise internal behaviour that has no
clause, so only those that test one carry its id.
